title: Sequence-level vocal convergence in common marmosets: reproducible repository
description: Reproducible repository accompanying the manuscript 'Sequence-level vocal convergence in common marmosets'. The repository contains extracted call WAV files, processed sequence and spectral tables, model-ready analysis tables, and final manuscript summary outputs.
